note: Wooded Cedar River bluff park near Mount Vernon, with CCC-built trails over limestone bluffs, Native American mounds, a stone lodge and a modern boat ramp on the river; campground in the woods on the bluff top. River Road and the campground close together for the winter. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
